mathematics.assertion_tested: For EUCL-DR1-L014994 only, solve spherical isolated simple-mu AQUAL reduced deflection(thetaE)=thetaE using exact Abel-deprojected Sersic stars and propagate approximate independent marginal measurement uncertainties.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 double precision SI units, log10 solar masses
mathematics.conventions: Euclid fiducial flat H0=67.74 km/s/Mpc Om=.3089. Lensing deflection assumes same potential for light and stellar motion. SED p16/p50/p84 split-scale Gaussian-quantile reconstruction; light theta and n independent split-scale normal or 1/3sigma quantile interpolation; spectroscopic redshifts Gaussian.
inputs: One named raw SED row and model summary row, verified spectroscopic redshifts; a0=9.3603e-11 and 1.1312e-10 m/s2
non_claims: No full image fit or non-spherical field solution.
No definitive theory failure, calibrated p-value, or universal theorem.
No native joint posterior; catalogue-summary tails and independence are assumptions.
Excludes stellar population/IMF, 3D geometry, environment, screening, external convergence and cosmology systematics.
No new SED fit at spectroscopic redshift.
